weights_are: EMA weights from the best checkpoint
output: sigmoid(logit) = probability FAKE; predict FAKE when prob >= threshold

inputs.face: RGB 256x256, float32 in [0,1], shape (N,3,256,256); ImageNet normalization is inside the model
inputs.eyes: RGB 96x96, float32 in [0,1], shape (N,3,96,96); ImageNet normalization is inside the model
inputs.dct: float32 map 128x128, shape (N,1,128,128); same values as the dataset .npy files

warning: Face crops, eye crops and DCT maps must be produced by the SAME preprocessing that generated the training dataset, or predictions will not be reliable.
